claims.statement: Chandragupta and Seleucus reached a settlement after conflict near the Indus. Their agreement connected the Mauryan state with one of the kingdoms formed after Alexander’s death. The early evidence does not clearly establish who won the fighting. Later accounts have turned that uncertainty into very different stories.

Chandragupta and Seleucus make peace: 305 BCE to 303 BCE. One episode within approximately 305–303 BCE, following Jansari’s publisher synopsis. This range does not establish three years of uninterrupted warfare or a precise treaty date.
